en.title: DOJ Settlement Spurs Accessibility Upgrades at Durham Park; Global Tech and Sports Boost Inclusion
en.summary: Two decades after a DOJ settlement, Durham’s West Point on the Eno park has completed accessibility upgrades including paved trails and accessible restrooms. Meanwhile, Google rebranded NotebookLM as Gemini Notebook with accessibility focus, and the Bundesliga expanded U.S. broadcast access with closed captioning and audio description. Additional highlights include an accessible Shakespeare production, research on heat‑related cognitive decline in seniors, and an iOS tip for reducing white point.

zh-TW.title: DOJ和解後達勒姆公園無障礙升級；Google、德甲及劇場提升無障礙
zh-TW.summary: 司法部和解二十年後，達勒姆西點恩諾公園完成無障礙改善，包括鋪設小徑與無障礙廁所。同時，Google 將 NotebookLM 重新品牌為 Gemini Notebook 強調無障礙，德甲聯賽透過新合作擴大美國廣播的閉合字幕與聲音描述。此外，《如你所願》劇場加入字幕與感官友善演出，北里大學研究指出高溫影響老年認知，以及 iOS 降低白點值技巧有助閱讀。
